neighbours.label: An instruction to click an unspecified interface object, with a direct indefinite object after click.
fire: To inspect the preview, click a thumbnail near the bottom of the gallery.
When the page has loaded, click an icon beside the item you want.
For more detail, click a link in the list of available resources.
After opening the dashboard, click a button to start a new session.
If you need another view, click an arrow at the edge of the panel.
On the results screen, click a row to inspect its complete record.
To enlarge the drawing, click an image in the selection window.
Once the menu appears, click a tab to switch between the sections.
quiet: A preview opens when you click on the chosen thumbnail in the gallery.
Beside your chosen item, click on the appropriate icon after the page loads.
The resource list provides more detail if you click on the selected link.
A new dashboard session begins when you click on the start button.
At the panel edge, click on the right arrow for another view.
The complete record appears after you click on the highlighted row.
In the selection window, click on the current image to enlarge the drawing.
The menu lets you switch sections when you click on the corresponding tab.

notes: This tests the direct indefinite-object construction against click on plus a definite object, keeping interface instructions throughout. The card also peaks on name of and talking about; this narrow construction is a candidate sub-trigger, not a claim to explain all of the pole.
